title: Value under parity-to-satisfaction conversion
statement: Let $P$ be a nonempty finite collection of three-variable linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$, with every declared variable appearing in at least one equation, and let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to its variables. Convert each equation into the four three-literal clauses specified by the even Boolean triples, with the clause signs determined by the equation's right-hand side, and let $P'$ be the resulting instance. The fraction of clauses in $P'$ satisfied by $x$ equals $\frac34$ plus one quarter of the fraction of equations in $P$ satisfied by the corresponding assignment over $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: The source instance has a nonempty multiset of constraints
Every declared variable occurs in some constraint scope
The assignment maps variables to Boolean values
